novelty_flags.label: prop:no-borrowing-sanity
novelty_flags.one_line: The no-borrowing AIPW limit is a required sanity reduction but is already contained in YangLiWuYang2026, so it cannot be counted as novel content.

soundness_flags.label: sampling_model and ass:iid-sampling
soundness_flags.one_line: The core treats n_R and n_E as deterministic stratum sizes while also imposing iid draws from one mixture law with random R; these imply incompatible sample designs and leave prefix indexing ill-defined.

soundness_flags.label: U_n, S_{n,k}, psi_{n,k}, and the estimated-prefix objects
soundness_flags.one_line: U_n(z) uses a unit-specific tie breaker V although z=(x,y) excludes it, and psi_{n,k}, tauhat_{n,k}, and Gammahat_n are described rather than defined as mathematical functionals.

soundness_flags.label: ass:loss-smoothness
soundness_flags.one_line: Its tag says smooth convex M-estimation, but the stated condition assumes only twice continuous differentiability; the cited Yang paper explicitly specifies a twice-differentiable convex loss.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nuisance-estimability
soundness_flags.one_line: Membership in the law class is made to depend on a particular cross-fitting procedure; state existence of L2 estimators at the rate as a property of the nuisances, then specify the chosen learners in the estimator construction.

soundness_flags.label: thm:modulus-dichotomy
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed iff and its near-tie bound are the sequential and setwise unpacking of the supremum-limsup definition of omega-star; replace this headline with an independent coercivity identity or finite-prefix characterization.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Section 3.2; p. 8, equation (2); pp. 12-14, Theorems 1-3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the trial-only AIPW estimator, specifies the influence-model loss as twice differentiable and convex, gives fixed-set bias/normality in Theorem 1, an MSE rate for any given borrowed set in Theorem 2, and fixed-ranking positive-separation selection consistency in Theorem 3.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Assumption 3.2 and discussion around equations (3.7)-(3.8)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: DML conditions control nuisance quality for a low-dimensional target and derive an L2 product-rate implication; they do not themselves supply a uniform rate over a growing generated prefix family.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 9, Theorem 4.1 and surrounding uniform-band discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The sorted-effects result gives inference uniformly over a compact subset of quantile indices, supporting the proposal's interior-versus-endpoint distinction.

source_verification_receipts.version: AOAS 18 (2024); primary page inaccessible to fetch, corroborated against arXiv:2107.01513
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The corroborating preprint states a fixed focused-estimator local law and worst-case coverage at least 1-alpha-gamma. No adverse formula or theorem-number mismatch is asserted without the primary text.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Specify a stratified triangular-array design with fixed n_R,n_E, include V in the external record and population rank, and write exact fold-level formulas for psi, tauhat, vhat, and Gammahat.

Replace the modulus dichotomy's definitional iff with an independently testable prefix-Gram coercivity theorem or an explicit finite-support counterexample family; retain the modulus only as its corollary.
Move the trial-only AIPW statement into a labeled sanity corollary and make the generated-ranking coupling or a proved coercivity/counterexample result the sole novelty-bearing headline.

Retag the loss assumption to match its actual differentiability content or add convexity and the score/Hessian moment and stochastic-equicontinuity conditions needed to linearize the generated ranking.

recommended_next_step: Revise the sampling and estimator definitions, repair the mislabeled and procedure-dependent assumptions, and replace the modulus unpacking with an independent coercivity/counterexample theorem before Stage 0.
